description: Make an earlier deployed version of a workflow live again in the user's Cloudflare account, replacing what is running now. Get version numbers from list_workflow_versions. Only do this when the user asks. Refused if the owner turned off deploys for this connection. For a durable workflow, the answer warns about runs the outgoing version left in flight. Set restoreDraft to also load that version back as the editable draft.

restoreDraft.description: Also replace the editable draft with this version's graph. Default false.

versionNumber.description: The version to make live, from list_workflow_versions.

workflowId.description: The workflow's id, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: rollback_workflow
title: Roll back workflow
